summary: Qgo Finance reported a 43.6% YoY rise in net profit to ₹120.92 lakh for Q2FY27. Interest income grew 32.8% YoY. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹0.15 per share.

headline: Paytm Q2 net profit jumps to ₹2.26 billion
summary: Paytm reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹2.26 billion, a sharp rise from ₹210 million YoY. Revenue grew to ₹26.48 billion, though results missed analyst estimates.

headline: One 97 to invest ₹500 crore in Paytm Cloud
summary: One 97 Communications plans to invest up to ₹500 crore in its subsidiary Paytm Cloud Technologies. The company also anticipates a 2.5 bps increase in payment processing margin due to MDR changes.

headline: AI Champdany shareholders approve director continuation
summary: AI Champdany Industries Ltd shareholders passed a special resolution to continue Jayanta Jash as Independent Director despite age limit, with 99.99% equity votes in favour.

headline: Alldigi Tech to consider share buyback, Q2 results
summary: Alldigi Tech Limited board will meet on October 29, 2026, to consider a proposal for the buyback of its equity shares and review Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: Sunteck Realty Q2FY27: Net profit jumps 17% YoY
summary: Sunteck Realty reported a 17% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹5,711 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 27% YoY to ₹3,208 crore.

headline: Kreon Financial discloses H1FY27 related party deals
summary: Kreon Financial Services disclosed related party transactions for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Key items include executive remuneration and rent payments to Opti Products Private Limited.

headline: Paytm Q2FY27 profit jumps 10x to ₹225 crore
summary: One 97 Communications reported a net profit of ₹225 crore for Q2FY27, up from ₹21 crore YoY. Revenue rose 28% to ₹2,648 crore. Board approved ₹500 crore investment in subsidiaries.

headline: Bhilwara Tech Textiles passes key resolutions
summary: Bhilwara Technical Textiles shareholders approved re-appointments of MD Shekhar Agarwal and Independent Director Rakesh Kumar Ojha, along with asset mortgage creation.

headline: WeWork India Q2FY27: PAT jumps to ₹204 crore
summary: WeWork India Management Limited reported a consolidated net profit of ₹204.35 crore for Q2FY27, up from a loss in the prior quarter, driven by strong revenue growth.

headline: Amara Raja appoints Preetam Ganguly as CBO
summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility appointed Preetam Ganguly as Chief Business Officer - Industrial effective October 26, 2026. He succeeds Venkata Krishna M M.

headline: Qgo Finance exempt from RPT disclosure
summary: Qgo Finance Limited claims exemption from SEBI Regulation 23(9) related party transaction disclosures. Net worth of ₹21.14 crore falls under Reg 15(2) limits.

headline: 360 ONE WAM schedules investor meetings for Nov 2026
summary: 360 ONE WAM Ltd will participate in four institutional investor conferences in November 2026. The company will discuss its H1FY26 results with investors.

headline: Padmanabh Alloys Q2FY27 Results
summary: Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers reports a massive net loss of ₹92,471.26 lakh in Q2FY27 due to a deferred tax charge, despite PBT rising to ₹148.31 lakh.

headline: SMC Global Securities Q2FY27 standalone PAT at ₹948 lakhs
summary: SMC Global Securities board approved Q2FY27 standalone and consolidated financial results on October 26, 2026. Standalone PAT for Q2FY27 stood at ₹948.14 lakhs, up from ₹634.20 lakhs in Q2FY26.

headline: Mardia Samyoung Q2FY27 Results
summary: Mardia Samyoung Capillary Tubes reports ₹97.86 lakh net profit for Q2FY27, a significant turnaround from the previous year's loss. Revenue surged to ₹2,337.62 lakh.

headline: R Systems appoints Vikas Basra as Chief AI Officer
summary: R Systems International appoints Vikas Basra as Chief AI Officer and Senior Management Personnel, effective October 26, 2026. He brings 24 years of global AI experience.

headline: Lodha Developers to host Q2FY27 results call
summary: Lodha Developers Limited announced an analyst conference call for November 2, 2026, to discuss Q2FY27 and H1FY27 financial results.

headline: Omaxe approves new subsidiary for PPP real estate projects
summary: Omaxe Limited approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary to undertake real estate projects under the Public-Private Partnership model.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Tanneries director exits
summary: Glen Sylvester Mascarenhas ceases as Independent Director of Andhra Pradesh Tanneries Ltd on October 26, 2026, completing his second term.

headline: 3M India board approves Solventum agreement amendments
summary: 3M India's board approved amendments to distribution and LMRA agreements with Solventum. Key changes include product scope adjustments following Thermo Fisher divestiture and a two-year term extension.

headline: One 97 Communications board meeting concludes
summary: One 97 Communications Limited concluded its Board of Directors meeting on October 26, 2026. The session, which began at 7:51 pm, ended at 10:15 pm.

headline: WeWork India board approves amended UPSI code
summary: WeWork India Management Limited's board approved an amended Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI on October 26, 2026, ensuring compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Gulf Oil Lubricants to host analyst meet Oct 29
summary: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited announced a physical institutional investors and analysts meet scheduled for October 29, 2026, in Mumbai, under SEBI regulations.

headline: Apollo Micro WTD to feature on NDTV Profit KYC
summary: Apollo Micro Systems announced that Addepalli Krishna Sai Kumar, Whole Time Director, will appear on NDTV Profit's 'KYC' show. The interview is scheduled for telecast on October 28, 2026.

headline: Trident Lifeline Q2FY27: Profit up 38%, declares dividend
summary: Trident Lifeline Limited reported a 37.7% YoY rise in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹0.50 per share.

headline: HOC completes land sale to BPCL for ₹166.14 crore
summary: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Ltd finalized the registration for selling 92.258 acres of land at Rasayani to BPCL for approximately ₹166.14 crore.
